mod.name: Project: OpenWig Bridge
mod.author: Axyom
mod.description: Starts OpenWig's local JSON-RPC bridge (127.0.0.1:7778) and MCP server (http://127.0.0.1:7779/mcp) so agents can read and edit the open project: tracks, devices, modulators, clips, automation and transport, each edit as one undo step.
